summary: Waste Energy Corp. filed an 8-K reporting board-approved unregistered equity issuances: 15,000,000 restricted shares to 221 Cap for services, plus conversions of accrued compensation at $0.005 per share into 7,500,000 shares for Scott Gallagher ($37,500 owed) and 6,000,000 shares for director W. Scott McBride ($30,000 owed). No cash proceeds, underwriting discounts, or commissions apply, and shares were unissued as of filing. Related Item 5.02(e) executive compensatory arrangements are routine. This is an ordinary small-cap capitalization action, not a special situation; watch resulting dilution, ownership shifts, and transfer-agent issuance mechanics.
